status: PREDECLARED before any run, 2026-10-17, executant w2:pC, protocol w2:p6 (docs/END_TO_END_E2E4_LOT.txt incl. amendment 1 §7). CPU only, no regeneration, no GPU, no retraining.

model.alphabet: built from the train pages (build_alphabet), as at the E2E-1 run

replay_control.rule: mismatch -> status MISMATCH and no reading

pages.source: e2e3 run 3 output (Kaggle dataset of babaorum-e2e3-run3-fp-classes), folder e2e3/mf, not regenerated

fusion.gap: gap(A,B) = x(start of B) - x(end of A), px of the scaled page; the same function for measurement and fusion (amendment 1)
fusion.condition_iii: |end-y of A - start-y of B| <= 0.5 * h_target
fusion.condition_iv: angle difference between last segment of A and first segment of B <= 10 degrees
fusion.G_units: G is reported in px AND in e
fusion.order: sort by (start y, start x, extraction index); each chain grows with the smallest gap, ties by sort key

hesp.ratio: r = g / e ; g horizontal gap in px (gap()), e = median of GT word gaps in px of the same scale (setting pages)
hesp.e_fallback: 0.3 h (median GT height) only if no word box exists
hesp.rule: supported if median(r) in [0.5, 2] AND >= 50 % of r in [0.5, 2]; otherwise 'coupures non expliquées par les espaces'

readings.R5_rule: extraction suffisante if precision_mean >= 0.5 AND recall_mean >= 0.5768 - 0.02 (B3, after fusion)
readings.R6_ref_source: E2E-1 calibration_report.json, arm S2 at step 2000: after_precision_mean 0.7960, after_recall_mean 0.9677 (precision then recall, as written in the lot)
readings.R6_rule: no drop > 0.02 in precision or recall; otherwise 'fusion trop agressive' and R5 not read as a success
readings.remedy_lambda: 1/6 on the CTC gradient entering enc_det, derived from R4 median 6.08 rounded before the lot; NOT run here (GPU, separate lot)

budget.cap_scope: inference only: starts after the page-cache step
budget.intermediate: G fixed written to the folder of --report (e2e4_G_fixed.json), before evaluation; nothing is written under --tmp (read-only input on Kaggle)
budget.cap_note: amendment 2 (§8) of 17/10/2026: 60 -> 150 min after the Kaggle read-only failure

page_cache.accept: exactly 60 JSON and 60 PNG; sha256 per file in the report

run_gate: NOT launched: waits for the GO of w2:p6 after the freeze and the 30-min delay of pK
